title: UFV-02 (AC-17 / SPEC R4): this fork assertion has not run under the real fork project
severity_rationale: S2 by the plan: an unexecuted rail assertion can hide a fork-mode leak. Capital none: no fork test runs against live funds and the bot is off.

evidence.note: Assertion: fork project rails (SPEC R4) > in-worker fork shell key: ETH_FORK_RPC_URL is present, non-empty, not the sentinel, and preserved (AC-17) Why not run: npm run test:fork starts Hardhat through the fork globalSetup (test/fork/setup.ts), and Phase 22 runs no Hardhat command (AC-08) Rehearsal: test/rails/vitest.fork-rehearsal.config.ts run wrapped with ETH_FORK_RPC_URL=http://127.0.0.1:9/rehearsal-marker (a dead loopback marker; nothing connected to it); ledger fork-shell-key ETH_FORK_RPC_URL preserved, ALLOW_REAL_MAINNET absent Result: pass (vpu-20261107T042012-23448-c57d66)

sibling_sites_checked: Each entry of unrun-fork-verifications.json has one obligation. Proven meanwhile by: test/unit/rails/childRails.test.ts 'fork shell keys (SPEC R4 / AC-17)' cases (i)-(vii) in railsEntry 'setup-fork' children
escaped_regression: A fork worker where the real ETH_FORK_RPC_URL is lost or replaced by the sentinel under the real fork project would pass the rehearsal, because the rehearsal uses a loopback marker.
recommendation: Run it by name at the first npm run test:fork of v7.0, owner Phase 25 (ROADMAP Phase 25 success criterion 3) or any earlier phase that runs the fork suite, and record pass or fail for this named assertion.
